native_g1g2_mms_alignment.g1_builder: The candidate G1 builder rebuilds exact u/f compiler expressions from the authored rational parameters and binds the exact symmetric affine 3x3 coefficient matrices into the typed K field; no source authority is added.

It does not verify provenance hashes or claim geometry authority.
native_g1g2_mms_alignment.bundle_construction_and_validation: The later native consumer reconstructs the matrix-valued coefficient bundle from the same frozen source record and requires exact canonical equality with authored G1/G2 declarations before Gridap. This candidate is software-only; G1/G2 authority remains typed_absent.

source_expression_record.pin_policy: The matrix-valued K variant is candidate-only and omits derived source-expression/bundle digests. Its later native consumer reconstructs and exact-compares the program bundle from the same authored rational matrix fields.

frozen_contract.reference: product bubble over physical Cartesian metres; zero on all six faces
frozen_contract.formula: u=product(t_i*(1-t_i)); K(x)=K0+sum(x_c*Kc), symmetric positive definite over the declared physical box; f=-div(K*grad(u)); all six faces zero Dirichlet.

native_g1g2_mms_alignment.next_run_gate: The UP1 consumer verifies the frozen native_mms_source_expressions.json record pins, expression hashes, identity and parameter labels, invokes the unique up4_r2_build_g1_design(source_expressions) and up4_r2_build_g2_design(source_expressions) with that same record, and completes the source-only T0/recheck/T1 chain without RuntimeV4/compiler. The record must state compiler_rebuild_required=true; exact bundle reconstruction/canonical comparison, native compiler acceptance, fresh T1 package binding, source-authority recheck and any solver work belong to a separate later native gate. No numerical or physical credit is granted here.
